pcvs.name: blocks_released

pcvs.name: blocks_becoming_free
pcvs.rationale: Counts blocks eligible to return to the free queue, distinguishing their additional work from releasing shared cached blocks.

attempts.hypothesis: Block-release work was constant in the first measurement. Request-table cardinality captures varying bookkeeping state during batch completion and permits testing whether the nearly fixed release cost has residual dependence on table size.
